skills.name: Merciful Voyage
skills.description: Upon entering battle, Mazu restores HP equal to 200% of her ATK to the ally with the lowest HP, plus an additional 10% of the target's missing HP.

upgrades.level3: The healing also affects one additional allied unit.
upgrades.level4: Healing based on missing HP is increased to 25%.

skills.name: Sacred Grail Divination
skills.description: At the start of battle, all allied units perform a divination. If the result is 'Holy Grail', they gain 100 Energy and a 45% ATK increase.

upgrades.level2: If 'Holy Grail' is rolled, Mazu also gains 50% ATK.
upgrades.level3: If 'Holy Grail' is rolled, Mazu instead gains 55% ATK.
upgrades.level4: If 'Holy Grail' is rolled, Mazu instead gains 60% ATK.

skills.name: Heavenly Sacred Decree
skills.description: For each living allied unit, Mazu takes 10% less damage and her Time Energy recovery is increased by 5%.

upgrades.level2: Damage reduction per living ally is increased to 15%.
upgrades.level3: Time Energy recovery per living ally is increased to 10%.
upgrades.level4: Damage reduction per living ally is increased to 20%.

skills.name: Merciful Domain
skills.description: Grants all allied units a shield equal to 200% of Mazu's ATK. For 8 seconds, 40% of damage taken is converted into delayed damage and dealt gradually over the next 5 seconds.

upgrades.level2: Shield strength is increased to 300% ATK.
upgrades.level3: Shield strength is increased to 400% ATK.
upgrades.level4: Shield strength is increased to 500% ATK.

relic.name: Compassionate Blessing
relic.description: When Merciful Domain is cast, allied units gain 30% ATK for 8 seconds.

upgrades.level10: Merciful Domain converts 50% of incoming damage into delayed damage over 5 seconds.
upgrades.level20: Mazu gains 200 Energy upon entering battle.
upgrades.level30: Merciful Domain converts 50% of incoming damage into delayed damage over 7 seconds.

coreMechanic.summary: Sustained channel damage that scales the longer it is held, paired with a stationary state that boosts damage and Lifesteal when Charon does not move. His defensive tools use banish effects to remove threats from the battlefield temporarily rather than killing them outright.
